descriptionChirho: A verb used only in the Piel stem (poetic and late), meaning to tell, declare, or make known -- an Aramaic loanword cognate with Aramaic chavvei. Elihu uses it extensively in Job: declaring his opinion (Job 32:6, 10, 17), showing what he knows (Job 15:17; 36:2). The heavens 'declare' God's handiwork night after night (Ps 19:2). All occurrences share the core sense of verbal communication or revelation of knowledge, whether human discourse or cosmic testimony to divine glory.
